_meta.note: SCORES ARE INTENTIONALLY NULL. To populate them with the verified official leaderboard values, either (a) run `python scripts/fetch_leaderboard.py --output baselines/timemmd_leaderboard.json`, which scrapes the README of github.com/AdityaLab/Time-MMD and writes the verified values into this file, or (b) manually paste the values from the GitHub leaderboard table into the `scores` objects below. Until `fetched_on` is set to a real ISO-8601 timestamp, every `scores` entry MUST be null and MUST NOT be cited in any publication. This schema is shipped intentionally empty to honor the zero-hallucination constraint: the bundle never reports a baseline number that has not been verified against the upstream source.
